title: GraphWake: Group Polarization via Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade in LLM-Agent Communities
abstract: arXiv:2608.17665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-driven agents can autonomously exchange opinions on online platforms and form communities. Such agent-operated social platforms raise a new security concern: attackers may manipulate agents to induce group polarization. Existing methods manipulate agent prompts or construct echo chambers, both of which are difficult to realize in practice. We therefore formulate a new threat, Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade, which uses agent memory as a persistence channel and public discussion as a propagation channel. This threat contains three stages. During exposure and memory retention, the attacker exposes a small set of target agents to arguments that reinforce their respective stated stances. The targets' memory systems then process and retain these arguments. translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.17665v1 公告类型：新 摘要：由大型语言模型驱动的代理可以在在线平台上自主交换意见并形成社区。这种代理运营的社交平台引发了新的安全担忧：攻击者可能操纵代理以诱导群体极化。现有方法操纵代理提示或构建回声室，这两种方法在实践中都难以实现。因此，我们提出了一种新的威胁，即记忆介导的极化级联，该威胁利用代理记忆作为持久性通道，并利用公开讨论作为传播通道。该威胁包含三个阶段。在暴露和记忆保留阶段，攻击者将一小部分目标代理暴露于强化其各自既定立场的论点中。目标代理的记忆系统随后处理并保留这些论点。在检索和复现阶段，一个共享的立场中立讨论线索促使目标代理检索并复现其各自保留的论点。在迭代传播阶段，
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的群体极化攻击威胁——记忆介导的极化级联，利用代理记忆作为持久通道和公开讨论作为传播通道，通过三个阶段的攻击过程在LLM代理社区中引发群体极化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new group polarization attack threat, Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade, which leverages agent memory as a persistence channel and public discussion as a propagation channel to induce group polarization in LLM-agent communities through a three-stage attack process.
